content: I am a fifth-year PhD candidate in Applied Mathematics at Harvard University, advised by Finale Doshi-Velez. I develop interpretable machine-learning methods for clinical decision-making, with applications in cardiovascular imaging and precision psychiatry. I am part of Harvard’s Data to Actionable Knowledge Lab and the Fahed Lab at the Broad Institute and Massachusetts General Hospital.
